summary: Turn a topic into an original narrated audiobook and listen on your Kobo.
release_notes: Line up a table's columns under the headings that name them, typeset numbered equations, set figures apart from the prose, and carry a document's mathematics all the way through instead of stopping early.
user: Somebody who wants a long listen made from a topic they choose.
job: Turn a topic into an original narrated audiobook and listen to it on your Kobo.
offline: Audiobooks already made play without the network; making a new one needs it.

data.location: the app's shelf storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; making one again takes a new request

data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; they keep a half-heard book resumable

capabilities_required.name: network
capabilities_required.purpose: to have your topic narrated into an audiobook

capabilities_required.name: audio
capabilities_required.purpose: to play the narration on the reader

capabilities_optional.name: bluetooth-audio
capabilities_optional.gates: listening on Bluetooth headphones or speakers

non_goals: It does not narrate your own documents.
It does not store anything in the cloud for you.
